evals.prompt: sync my argocd app called payment-service to the latest commit
evals.expected_output: Runs argocd app diff first, then argocd app sync with --dry-run, then the actual sync. Follows the diff-before-sync convention.

assertions.text: Runs argocd app diff before syncing
Runs argocd app sync with --dry-run first
Runs argocd app sync payment-service
Includes --prune flag or explains why it is omitted

evals.prompt: my argocd app is showing degraded health, help me figure out what's wrong
evals.expected_output: Starts with argocd app get to inspect status, then argocd app resources to find unhealthy resources, then kubectl describe or argocd app logs for the specific failing resource.

assertions.text: Runs argocd app get as the first diagnostic step
Runs argocd app resources to identify degraded resources
Checks logs or describes the failing resource

evals.prompt: I need to roll back the checkout-service argocd app to the previous deployment because the latest release broke payments
evals.expected_output: Recommends Git revert as the primary rollback path. Falls back to argocd app history and argocd app rollback only if Git revert is not feasible. Mentions post-rollback Git reconciliation.

assertions.text: Recommends Git revert as the primary rollback method
Mentions argocd app history to inspect previous deployments
Mentions argocd app rollback as emergency fallback
Mentions need to reconcile Git after emergency rollback

evals.prompt: create an argocd application for our new microservice that deploys from the gitops repo to the staging cluster
evals.expected_output: Runs argocd app create with --repo, --path, --dest-server, --dest-namespace, --project, and --sync-policy none. Explains why manual sync is the default.

assertions.text: Uses argocd app create command
Includes --repo and --path flags
Includes --dest-server and --dest-namespace flags
Sets --sync-policy none and explains the reasoning

evals.prompt: check the diff between what's in git and what's running in the cluster for the api-gateway argocd app
evals.expected_output: Runs argocd app diff api-gateway. Explains exit code meaning (0 = no diff, 1 = differences). May also run argocd app get with --refresh for live comparison.

assertions.text: Runs argocd app diff api-gateway
Explains exit code semantics

evals.prompt: set up a project-scoped role token for our CI pipeline to sync apps in the frontend project
evals.expected_output: Creates a project role, adds sync and get policies, generates a JWT token with expiration. Recommends using ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN in CI.

assertions.text: Uses argocd proj role create to create the role
Uses argocd proj role add-policy for sync and get permissions
Uses argocd proj role create-token to generate the token
Sets token expiration with --expires-in

evals.prompt: we have 30 microservices that all need to deploy to 4 clusters, what's the best way to manage this with argocd
evals.expected_output: Recommends ApplicationSets over app-of-apps given the scale (>20 apps, >3 clusters). Suggests Matrix generator combining Git directory generator with Cluster generator. Mentions preserveResourcesOnDeletion for production safety.

assertions.text: Recommends ApplicationSets based on the scale criteria
Mentions Matrix generator for the cross-product use case
Mentions preserveResourcesOnDeletion for safety

evals.prompt: deploy my application to kubernetes using kubectl apply
evals.expected_output: This is a kubectl operation, not an ArgoCD CLI operation. Should not trigger the using-argocd-cli skill.

assertions.text: Does not invoke ArgoCD CLI commands
Uses kubectl apply as requested

evals.prompt: install the argocd server on my kubernetes cluster using helm
evals.expected_output: This is an ArgoCD server installation request, not an ArgoCD CLI application management request. Should not trigger the using-argocd-cli skill.

assertions.text: Uses helm install or helm upgrade for ArgoCD server installation
Does not use argocd CLI commands for server installation

evals.prompt: set up flux to sync my git repository with my kubernetes cluster
evals.expected_output: This is a Flux CD request, not an ArgoCD request. Should not trigger the using-argocd-cli skill.

assertions.text: Uses flux CLI or Flux CRDs, not ArgoCD
Does not suggest ArgoCD as a replacement

evals.prompt: write a kubernetes deployment manifest for a node.js app with 3 replicas
evals.expected_output: This is a general Kubernetes manifest authoring request. Should not trigger the using-argocd-cli skill.

assertions.text: Generates a Kubernetes Deployment YAML manifest
Does not invoke ArgoCD CLI commands
